subtitle: 刘纪霆
headline: Multimodal Foundation Models & Embodied AI
bioMarkdown:
My research interests are broad, with a primary focus on **multimodal foundation models and embodied AI**. Recently, I have been exploring **parameter generation**, **recursive self-improvement (RSI)**, and **embodied agents**.

Previously, I was a Research Assistant at the [MINT Lab](https://mint-sjtu.github.io/) at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, where I worked on embodied AI in [Prof. Bo Zhao’s](https://soai.sjtu.edu.cn/cn/facultydetails/zzjs/zhaobo) group, with guidance from [Prof. Gen Li](https://www.genli.top/), [Tao Lin](https://dorayakilin.github.io/), and [Yuxin Du](https://yuxin-du-lab.github.io/).

I also served as a Research Assistant at the [Miro Dynamics–HKU CGVU Joint Lab](https://hku-cg.github.io/mirod-lab/) in [Prof. Taku Komura’s](https://www.cs.hku.hk/index.php/people/academic-staff/taku) group at the University of Hong Kong, where I studied cross-embodiment action retargeting for dexterous manipulation under the guidance of [Zhouyingcheng Liao](https://zycliao.com/) and [Dr. Wenjia Wang](https://wenjiawang0312.github.io/).
